_doc: Evaluation thresholds (evals/run_evals.py; prose in evals/README.md). Each case runs runs_per_case times (1 in quick mode); a case counts a rule as found, or its verdict as matched, when at least case_majority runs agree. Rates are over cases, except invalid_output_rate, which is over runs and reported separately with no threshold. min_counts apply only to agents used by a route (config/routes.json). Never lower a threshold to make a run pass.
